from datetime import datetime, timezone
import hashlib
import json
import os
from pathlib import Path
import shutil
import subprocess
import time

HERE = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
REPO = HERE.parents[2]
MANIFEST = HERE / 'frozen-inputs.json'
SPEC = json.loads(MANIFEST.read_text(encoding='utf-8'))
CODEX = shutil.which('codex')
RD = ['rd-delivery', 'rd-requirement', 'rd-research', 'rd-feasibility',
      'rd-solution', 'rd-design', 'rd-specification', 'rd-writing', 'rd-review']
CREATE_FLAGS = subprocess.CREATE_NO_WINDOW if os.name == 'nt' else 0

def sha(data):
    return hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest()

def write_json(path, data):
    path.write_text(json.dumps(data, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2) + '\n', encoding='utf-8')

def run_cell(case, arm):
    cell = case['id'] + '-' + arm
    output = HERE / 'runs' / cell
    if output.exists():
        raise SystemExit('Refusing to overwrite an existing first-attempt cell: ' + cell)
    workspace = output / 'workspace'
    workspace.mkdir(parents=True)
    subprocess.run(['git', 'init', '-q', str(workspace)], check=True,
                   capture_output=True, creationflags=CREATE_FLAGS)
    for name, text in case['workspace_files'].items():
        path = workspace / name
        path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        path.write_text(text, encoding='utf-8')
    staged = workspace / '.agents/skills/rd-review'
    if case['group'] == 'native':
        source = REPO / 'zh-CN/skills/rd-review'
        for relative in ('SKILL.md', 'references', 'agents'):
            origin = source / relative
            target = staged / relative
            if origin.is_dir():
                shutil.copytree(origin, target)
            elif origin.exists():
                target.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
                shutil.copyfile(origin, target)
    selectors = ['{name="' + name + '",enabled=false}' for name in RD]
    if arm == 'with':
        selectors.append('{path=' + json.dumps((staged / 'SKILL.md').as_posix()) + ',enabled=true}')
    argv = [CODEX, 'exec', '--ephemeral', '--json', '--color', 'never',
            '--ignore-rules', '--sandbox', 'read-only', '--cd', str(workspace),
            '-m', SPEC['requested_model'],
            '-c', 'model_reasoning_effort="' + SPEC['requested_reasoning_effort'] + '"',
            '-c', 'model_verbosity="medium"',
            '-c', 'approval_policy="never"', '-c', 'project_doc_max_bytes=0',
            '-c', 'features.hooks=false', '-c', 'features.memories=false',
            '-c', 'features.apps=false', '-c', 'features.plugins=false',
            '-c', 'web_search="disabled"',
            '-c', 'skills.config=[' + ','.join(selectors) + ']',
            '-o', str(output / 'response.txt'), '-']
    prompt = case['task_text']
    if case['group'] == 'documents':
        argv += ['-c', 'features.shell_tool=false', '-c', 'features.unified_exec=false']
        prompt = ('<workflow-instructions>\n' + case['instruction_' + arm]
                  + '\n</workflow-instructions>\n\n' + prompt)
    (output / 'prompt.txt').write_text(prompt, encoding='utf-8')
    start_utc = datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat()
    started = time.perf_counter()
    try:
        result = subprocess.run(argv, input=prompt, text=True, encoding='utf-8',
                                errors='strict', capture_output=True,
                                timeout=SPEC['timeout_seconds'], creationflags=CREATE_FLAGS)
        stdout, stderr, code = result.stdout, result.stderr, result.returncode
    except subprocess.TimeoutExpired as error:
        stdout, stderr, code = error.stdout or b'', error.stderr or b'', 'timeout'
        stdout = stdout.decode('utf-8', 'strict') if isinstance(stdout, bytes) else stdout
        stderr = stderr.decode('utf-8', 'strict') if isinstance(stderr, bytes) else stderr
    duration = round(time.perf_counter() - started, 3)
    (output / 'events.local.jsonl').write_text(stdout, encoding='utf-8')
    (output / 'stderr.local.txt').write_text(stderr, encoding='utf-8')
    events, unparsed = [], 0
    for line in stdout.splitlines():
        try:
            events.append(json.loads(line))
        except json.JSONDecodeError:
            unparsed += 1
    items = [e.get('item', {}) for e in events if e.get('type') == 'item.completed']
    commands = [i for i in items if i.get('type') == 'command_execution']
    response_file = output / 'response.txt'
    response = response_file.read_text(encoding='utf-8') if response_file.exists() else ''
    skill_text = (staged / 'SKILL.md').read_text(encoding='utf-8') if staged.exists() else ''
    full_read = any(skill_text.strip() in c.get('aggregated_output', '').replace('\r\n', '\n')
                    and c.get('exit_code') == 0 for c in commands) if skill_text else False
    target_commands = [c for c in commands if 'rd-review' in c.get('command', '')]
    result_record = {
        'cell_id': cell, 'case_id': case['id'], 'arm': arm, 'group': case['group'],
        'started_utc': start_utc, 'elapsed_seconds': duration, 'exit_code': code,
        'prompt_sha256': sha(prompt.encode('utf-8')),
        'completed_item_types': [i.get('type') for i in items],
        'completed_commands': len(commands),
        'target_skill_commands': len(target_commands),
        'target_skill_command_exit_codes': [c.get('exit_code') for c in target_commands],
        'full_staged_skill_body_observed_in_successful_command': full_read,
        'turn_usage': [e.get('usage') for e in events if e.get('type') == 'turn.completed'],
        'error_event_types': [e.get('type') for e in events if e.get('type') in ('error', 'turn.failed')],
        'unparsed_event_lines': unparsed,
        'response_sha256': sha(response.encode('utf-8')), 'response': response,
        'raw_stdout_sha256': sha(stdout.encode('utf-8')),
        'raw_stderr_sha256': sha(stderr.encode('utf-8')),
    }
    write_json(output / 'result.json', result_record)
    print(json.dumps({k: result_record[k] for k in ('cell_id', 'exit_code', 'elapsed_seconds',
                     'completed_commands', 'target_skill_commands',
                     'full_staged_skill_body_observed_in_successful_command', 'turn_usage')},
                     ensure_ascii=False), flush=True)
    return result_record

if __name__ == '__main__':
    if not CODEX:
        raise SystemExit('Codex CLI unavailable')
    controls = {
        'manifest_sha256': sha(MANIFEST.read_bytes()),
        'cli_version': subprocess.check_output([CODEX, '--version'], text=True).strip(),
        'requested_model': SPEC['requested_model'],
        'requested_reasoning_effort': SPEC['requested_reasoning_effort'],
        'requested_verbosity': 'medium',

        'limits': ['inherited host/system and other installed Skill context not fully isolated',
                   'requested backend model identity not independently attested',
                   'one first response per cell; no statistical or production claim'],
        'native_skill_snapshot': {p.relative_to(REPO / 'zh-CN/skills/rd-review').as_posix():
                                 {'text': p.read_text(encoding='utf-8'), 'sha256': sha(p.read_bytes())}
                                 for p in (REPO / 'zh-CN/skills/rd-review').rglob('*')
                                 if p.is_file() and 'evals' not in p.parts},

    controls_path = HERE / 'run-controls.json'

    write_json(controls_path, controls)
    records = []

allowed_new = {'docs/rd-method-adoption.md', 'zh-CN/docs/rd-method-adoption.md',
               'docs/evidence/rd-role-adoption-2026-10-05.json'}
current = set(subprocess.check_output(['git', 'diff', '--name-only'], cwd=ROOT, text=True).splitlines()
              + subprocess.check_output(['git', 'ls-files', '--others', '--exclude-standard'], cwd=ROOT, text=True).splitlines())
changed = {p for p, digest in before.items() if not (ROOT / p).is_file() or sha((ROOT / p).read_bytes()) != digest}
assert changed == allowed_existing, changed
assert current - set(before) == allowed_new, current - set(before)
assert set(before) <= current
affected = sorted(allowed_existing | allowed_new)
for name in affected:
    raw = (ROOT / name).read_bytes()
    assert not raw.startswith(b'\xef\xbb\xbf') and b'\r' not in raw, name
    text = raw.decode('utf-8')
    assert not re.search(r'(?i)[A-Z]:[\\/](?:Users|Lee|Workspaces)|(?:ghp_|sk-)[A-Za-z0-9]{20,}', text), name
record = json.loads((ROOT / 'docs/evidence/rd-role-adoption-2026-10-05.json').read_text(encoding='utf-8'))
frozen_bytes = (json.dumps(record['frozen_inputs'], ensure_ascii=False, indent=2) + '\n').encode('utf-8')
assert sha(frozen_bytes) == record['frozen_input_sha256']
for source in record['frozen_inputs']['source_packet']['checked_repository_sources']:
    if source['path'].startswith('skills/'):
        assert sha((ROOT / source['path']).read_bytes()) == source['sha256'], source['path']
for source in record['frozen_inputs']['instruction_sources']:
    assert sha((ROOT / source['path']).read_bytes()) == source['sha256']
assert not any('/SKILL.md' in p or '/references/' in p for p in current)
assert record['source_review']['conclusion']['retain_first_draft'] is True
assert record['source_review']['findings'] == []
for cell in record['cells']:
    assert sha(cell['response'].encode('utf-8')) == cell['response_sha256']
    assert sha(cell['prompt'].encode('utf-8')) == cell['prompt_sha256']
    assert cell['exit_code'] == 0 and set(cell['completed_item_types']) == {'agent_message'}
assert len(record['cells']) == 2
assert len(record['frozen_inputs']['reader_questions']) == 7
assert record['observed_cli_totals']['elapsed_seconds_sum'] == round(sum(c['elapsed_seconds'] for c in record['cells']), 3)
for key, value in record['observed_cli_totals']['usage_sums'].items():
    assert value == sum(u.get(key, 0) for c in record['cells'] for u in c['turn_usage'])
assert not any((HERE / 'runs' / f'{stage}-run').exists() for stage in ['revise', 'read-after'])
definitions = {language: sum(len(json.loads(p.read_text(encoding='utf-8'))['evals'])
               for p in (ROOT / language).glob('rd-*/evals/evals.json')) for language in ['skills', 'zh-CN/skills']}
assert set(definitions.values()) == {51}, definitions

def slug(value):
    return re.sub(r'[^\w\- ]', '', value.replace('`', '').lower(), flags=re.UNICODE).replace(' ', '-')
links = 0
for name in sorted(allowed_new - {'docs/evidence/rd-role-adoption-2026-10-05.json'}):
    path = ROOT / name
    text = path.read_text(encoding='utf-8')
    rows = [line for line in text.splitlines() if line.startswith('| [`rd-')]
    assert len(rows) == 9, (name, len(rows))
    for dest in re.findall(r'\[[^\]]*\]\(([^()\n]+)\)', text):
        if '://' in dest or dest.startswith('mailto:'):
            continue
        file, _, anchor = dest.partition('#')
        target = (path.parent / unquote(file)).resolve() if file else path
        assert target.is_relative_to(ROOT.resolve()) and target.is_file(), (name, dest)
        if anchor:
            headings = [slug(m.group(1)) for m in re.finditer(r'^#{1,6} (.+)$', target.read_text(encoding='utf-8'), re.MULTILINE)]
            assert unquote(anchor) in headings, (name, dest, headings)
        links += 1
summary = {'status': 'passed', 'incremental_paths': affected,
           'unchanged_preexisting_paths': len(before) - len(changed), 'intended_existing_updates': len(changed),
           'new_paths': len(allowed_new), 'current_total_changed_paths': len(current), 'local_links_checked': links,
           'canonical_definitions': definitions, 'frozen_input_and_prompt_response_hashes': 'match',

           'all_affected_files': 'UTF-8 without BOM, LF, no detected personal paths or credential patterns',

(HERE / 'scope-check.json').write_text(json.dumps(summary, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2) + '\n', encoding='utf-8', newline='\n')
print(json.dumps(summary, ensure_ascii=False))
